Name: PepsiCo Inc
Description: PepsiCo, Inc. is a leading global food, snack, and beverage corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York. With a diverse portfolio that includes iconic brands such as Pepsi, Mountain Dew, Gatorade, and Frito-Lay, the company operates in more than 200 countries, leveraging its extensive manufacturing and distribution network to deliver a broad range of products to consumers worldwide. PepsiCo is committed to sustainable growth and innovation, continuously adapting to changing consumer preferences while focusing on environmental and social responsibility initiatives. Through strategic acquisitions and marketing efforts, the company maintains a robust market position and aims to enhance shareholder value in an increasingly competitive landscape.
